ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_LOCATION_SEC
AS
BEGIN
-------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION
AS(
	SELECT 
     CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(HOME_ADDR1, HOME_ADDR2, HOME_ADDR3, HOME_ZIP, HOME_COUNTRY)),1)  AS LocationId
    ,HOME_ADDR1 AS LocationAddressLine1
    ,HOME_ADDR2 AS LocationCity
    ,HOME_ADDR3 AS LocationStateId
    ,HOME_ZIP AS LocationZipCode
    ,HOME_COUNTRY AS CountryId
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1

UNION

	SELECT 
     CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(OFC_ADDR1, OFC_ADDR2, OFC_ADDR3, OFC_ZIP, OFC_COUNTRY)),1)  AS LocationId
    ,OFC_ADDR1 AS LocationAddressLine1
    ,OFC_ADDR2 AS LocationCity
    ,OFC_ADDR3 AS LocationStateId
    ,OFC_ZIP AS LocationZipCode
    ,OFC_COUNTRY AS CountryId
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1

UNION

	SELECT 
     CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(PERM_ADDR1, PERM_ADDR2, PERM_ADDR3, PERM_ZIP, PERM_COUNTRY)),1)  AS LocationId
    ,PERM_ADDR1 AS LocationAddressLine1
    ,PERM_ADDR2 AS LocationCity
    ,PERM_ADDR3 AS LocationStateId
    ,PERM_ZIP AS LocationZipCode
    ,PERM_COUNTRY AS CountryId
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION FROM TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 LocationId
,LocationAddressLine1
,LocationCity
,LocationStateId
,LocationZipCode
,CountryId
)) HASHROW, LocationId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 LocationId
,LocationAddressLine1
,LocationCity
,LocationStateId
,LocationZipCode
,CountryId
)) HASHROW, LocationId
FROM BNKM.Location WHERE SOURCECODE = 'SEC'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.LocationId,TGT.LocationId) AS LocationId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.LocationId = TGT.LocationId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA;

-------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 LocationId = SRC.LocationId
,LocationName = NULL
,LocationDescription = NULL
,LocationAddressLine1 = SRC.LocationAddressLine1
,LocationCity = SRC.LocationCity
,LocationStateId = SRC.LocationStateId
,LocationZipCode = SRC.LocationZipCode
,LocationNote = NULL
,LocationLatitude = NULL
,LocationLongitude = NULL
,LocationDatum = NULL
,LocationElevation = NULL
,LocationElevationUnitOfMeasureId = NULL
,GlobalLocationNumber = NULL
,TimezoneId = NULL
,DaylightSavingsTimeObservedIndicator = NULL
,CountryId = SRC.CountryId
,SubdivisionId = NULL
,LocationAddressLine3 = NULL
,LocationAddressLine4 = NULL
,LocationHouseNumber = NULL
,LocationBuildingName = NULL
,LocationUnitNumber = NULL
,LocationStreet = NULL
,LocationBarangay = NULL
FROM BNKM.Location TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.LocationId = TGT.LocationId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION SRC ON SRC.LocationId = TGT.LocationId ;
 


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO  BNKM.Location  ( 
LocationId
,LocationName
,LocationDescription
,LocationAddressLine1
,LocationCity
,LocationStateId
,LocationZipCode
,LocationNote
,LocationLatitude
,LocationLongitude
,LocationDatum
,LocationElevation
,LocationElevationUnitOfMeasureId
,GlobalLocationNumber
,TimezoneId
,DaylightSavingsTimeObservedIndicator
,CountryId
,SubdivisionId
,LocationAddressLine3
,LocationAddressLine4
,LocationHouseNumber
,LocationBuildingName
,LocationUnitNumber
,LocationStreet
,LocationBarangay
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 LocationId AS LocationId
,NULL AS LocationName
,NULL AS LocationDescription
,LocationAddressLine1 AS LocationAddressLine1
,LocationCity AS LocationCity
,LocationStateId AS LocationStateId
,LocationZipCode AS LocationZipCode
,NULL AS LocationNote
,NULL AS LocationLatitude
,NULL AS LocationLongitude
,NULL AS LocationDatum
,NULL AS LocationElevation
,NULL AS LocationElevationUnitOfMeasureId
,NULL AS GlobalLocationNumber
,NULL AS TimezoneId
,NULL AS DaylightSavingsTimeObservedIndicator
,CountryId AS CountryId
,NULL AS SubdivisionId
,NULL AS LocationAddressLine3
,NULL AS LocationAddressLine4
,NULL AS LocationHouseNumber
,NULL AS LocationBuildingName
,NULL AS LocationUnitNumber
,NULL AS LocationStreet
,NULL AS LocationBarangay
,SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCECODE
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA;

END
